Highly recommended for anyone looking for brighter, smoother, and healthier‑looking skin.

avis.titre: Well-Designed “Toner Serum” That Improves Absorption & Overall Results
avis.texte: This product is accurately described as a toner serum. It has the lightweight, fast-absorbing texture of a toner, but functions more like a treatment serum. Rather than focusing only on hydration, its real strength is how well it prepares the skin and enhances the performance of products applied afterward. With consistent use, I’ve noticed clearer skin, a brighter and more even tone, and gradual improvement in dark spots. The effect is especially noticeable when pairing it with active treatments such as vitamin C serums. How I use it (evening routine): In the evening, I apply a thin layer and gently pat until fully absorbed, then repeat this step 2–4 times, depending on how dry my skin feels that day. Building hydration gradually this way allows the skin to absorb moisture without heaviness and noticeably improves plumpness and overall moisture retention. Once the toner serum is fully absorbed, I apply my treatment serums (such as vitamin C), followed by a moisturizer with enough oil and hydration to seal everything in. Used this way, it clearly improves how well active serums absorb and perform, leaving the skin looking fuller, healthier, and well-hydrated. Morning use: I also use this in the morning, but usually apply just one light layer. It noticeably improves makeup application—foundation goes on more evenly, adheres better, and stays comfortable throughout the day without emphasizing dryness. avis.titre: Super lightweight, hydrating, reduces redness and plumps skin
avis.texte: COSRX 6 Peptide skin booster Size: 5.07 Fl. Oz. Scent: None -Phthalate-free -Sulfate-free -Paraben-free Key ingredients: -6 Peptide blend(SH-Polypeptide-121, Copper Tripeptide-1, Dipeptide Diaminobutyroyl Benzylamide Diacetate, Oligopeptide-68, Palmitoyl Tripeptide-8, Acetyl Hexapeptide-8) -Niacinamide -Hyaluronic acid -NAG(N-Acetyl Glucosamine) Benefits of ingredients: -Hydrated skin -Clearer skin -Brighter/more even skin tone -Reduces fine lines/wrinkles -Boosts collagen and plumps the skin It’s recommended that you apply this skin booster before your serums. It will help your skin absorb the serum better. I noticed that my skin feels really hydrated and firm when I use this skin booster. It also makes the lines in my face look less pronounced due to the extra hydration. I’ll have to use this more long term to get the full effects. So far, so good though!

avis.titre: Give Your Other Serums a Boost!
avis.texte: I’ve been noticing a surge in boosters lately & have actually used quite a few. Boosters give your other serums, well … a boost! It is recommended that you use this COSRX Booster before applying your other serums to enhance their effects. This is a lightweight serum, so it layers well with any additional products you apply. It is packed with some really excellent ingredients. I have to admit, my skin has been looking more youthful since adding this product to my routine, so yay for that!

You simply can't go wrong with any Korean skin products. I love them all. This is to be used right after you wash your face, which is designed to use before any other skincare products that you may use. Pat it gently to aid absorption. There are no unpleasant scent and for just $30 for 150ml size, it is very reasonable.

In my search to address the extremely dry condition of my skin, I purchased this product. It is unscented, has a lightweight consistency, and is swiftly absorbed. It has a slight tightening effect on the skin, which feels pleasant. My skin now has a beautiful radiance and a notably smoother texture. I’ve noticed my large pores seem smaller too. I intend to purchase again as well as other COSRX products.

This Korean made syrum is super thin and runny. The directions say to apply multiple layers. But it’s so sticky and uncomfortable on my skin. It’s too soon to know its long term effects. But so far it’s not really my favorite.

avis.titre: More watery than the Snail Mucin
avis.texte: I have really, really good skin. And I normally use the Cosrx Snail Mucin every day. I love that stuff. BUT as I'm getting older I feel like my skin needs something with a bit more umph. So I gave this a try. I have to say, I actually really like it. It is more watery than the snail mucin - so keep that in mind. I would use this before anything else - even under the snail mucin. It doesn't really have a smell and I feel like my skin really loves this. It feels softer - younger even if it can feel that way. Totally worth giving it a try. Definitely a good value.

I’ve had this saved in my wishlist for months. I like to do a lot of research before I dive into a new skincare routine. Right now my skin is a little drier (winter) and I do have some acne scars some light and others darker. I sometimes break out right before I get my period so I was looking for something to help with my blemishes (Copper tripeptide-1) and also to brighten my skin (Oligopelride-68) and also at 35 something for lines and wrinkles (Acetyl hexapepride-8) fortunately I haven’t seen any yet. When I search for skincare I lean more towards Korean skincare since they are known for 1 great skincare and 2 glass skin. I’m going to be using this 6 Peptide Skin Booster with the COSRX Vitamin C 23 serum and COSRX Advanced snail 92 All in One Cream. I plan on updating my review in 1,2 and 3 months. Also got the booster and serum on a bundle deal so also a plus since I saved over $8! Also there was a deal on the snail 92 all in one cream $9.97

avis.titre: Un espectáculo en conjunto — suave, ligero y mejora visiblemente la piel
avis.texte: Empecé usando productos de COSRX con la clásica baba de caracol, y desde ahí quedé encantada con la marca. Poco a poco fui incorporando más productos como el retinol, la crema hidratante y ahora este 6 Peptide Skin Booster, y tengo que decir que en conjunto hacen maravillas. Este serum es muy ligero, se absorbe al instante y deja la piel suave, luminosa y con una hidratación duradera sin sensación grasosa. Me gusta usarlo como primero producto, y siento que prepara muy bien la piel para lo que venga después. Además, no me ha causado irritación y eso es clave porque tengo piel sensible. Si estás empezando a construir tu rutina con productos eficaces y suaves, esta línea de COSRX es un espectáculo. La calidad, los ingredientes y los resultados realmente valen la pena

avis.titre: Good product, I even use it on my lips…
avis.texte: Good product, light, has all the good stuff. Makes my skin glow. Here’s an added bonus: I’ve been rubbing this into my lips for about 2-3 weeks. It has increased my volume quite a bit! I didn’t really want to buy an additional “lip product” so this is working well! Of course I add laneige lip sleeping mask, and/or other lip moisturizer, but they never changed my volume like this!
Serum para mi rutina de skin care, me gusta que es de buen tamaño 150 ml en comparación de los demas Serum que son por lo general de 30 ml.

avis.titre: Pores got smaller in the matter of days
avis.texte: The first product that has ever actually worked for me as far as shrinking my pores. I have been looking for a while now for a product that can do just this. In just a few days I noticed a difference in my skin. I have combo/sensitive skin and I bought this bc I felt my barrier was ruined from a different product I had used. This product I read can help fix the skin barrier and more. I noticed it felt very calming on my skin when I applied it and did not burn/hurt my skin or cause any redness with my already compromised skin. i will continue to repurchase!!

YES! feels like water on your face and leaves your skin feeling great. I use this tones along with the other Cosrx products and I have never been so happy with my skin. I am in my mid 40's and was looking for something to help with my skin elasticity and firmness. I've been using these product for 2 weeks now, twice a day and already see a difference. Very happy! My skin looks healthy and I never use any foundation, just sunscreen after all the other goodies.

avis.titre: Now I have discoloration marks and a horrible rash
avis.texte: Not for sensitive skin! I started using this and got neck discolorations in the worst way possible but couldn’t figure out what was causing it. After trying everything in my routine on its own to see what was causing hives, discoloration and a bad rash, I finally realized this is it. My neck has this horrible white spots all over that still can’t get back to its original color. I don’t know if I got a bad product, if it’s my skin that didn’t tolerate it or what, but please beware.

avis.titre: If you are allergic to dust mites, do not use!!!
avis.texte: Using this on my face caused a major allergic reaction. I researched snail mucin, and found that if you were allergic to dust mites, you should not use at all. Avoid if you are possibly allergic!
